thread:
incident-bot: 🚨 ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate detected on inference-gateway (5m window). Threshold exceeded: 2.7% (baseline ~0.15%). Auto-page: @maria_oncall

monitoring-bot: metrics snapshot: 5xx(5m)=2.7%, timeout(5m)=1.9%, median latency 120ms -> 520ms tail. Top error codes: 502, 504, upstream_conn_reset. Candidate origin: backend kv-store failures (increased misses + index errors).

maria_oncall: ack — I'm awake, jumping in. Starting triage.

maria_oncall: quick note — did we push anything to the kv-shard/kv-index service in the last 2 hours? @ajay_eng?

ajay_eng: I pushed a performance tweak to kv-indexing at 180 minutes ago — changed LFU decay params and enabled aggressive eviction on low-memory nodes (commit abc123). Rolling back now if useful.

kai_sre: seeing repeated log lines from kv-shard on node kv-54: 
```ERROR kv-shard[54]: index-mismatch detected: idx_header_crc != computed_crc (0x4f2a != 0x0)
WARN kv-shard[54]: fallback_to_disk=true
ERROR prefix-layer: failed to fetch prefix cache for model=stable-xl shard=12 err=corrupt_index
```

sophia_support: we're getting multiple customer tickets: "requests failing with 502" and long streaming stalls. Preliminary count shows ~20 paid customers hitting increased error rates. I'll open an incident-impact doc and message CSMs.

maria_oncall: immediate mitigation options: 1) disable prefix/persistent caching on frontends to force cold reads (reduces corrupt-index touch points) 2) roll back commit abc123 on kv-indexing 3) pre-warm fallback hot paths (increase disk reads but avoid 5xx). I'm going to try (1) first because it's quickest.

maria_oncall: running feature-flag toggle: 
```deploy-bot: run: /bin/rollout-flag --service=inference-gateway --flag=prefix_cache_persistent --set=false --env=prod
deploy-bot: queued toggle in us-west-2 -> applied to 60% frontends
```

monitoring-bot: flag toggle observed. Rolling median 5xx in the next 2m: 2.1% -> 1.4% (partial).

ajay_eng: prepping rollback of abc123 on kv-index across affected nodes. Rolling undo with controlled batch. Command: 
```kubectl -n infra rollout undo deployment/kv-index --to-revision=12
```

kai_sre: FYI, disk IO spiked on kv-54 and kv-57 during the event. We might be thrashing due to eviction cascade + small capacity on those pods. Adding OOM headroom nodes could help.

maria_oncall: support update to customers (quick blurb): "We're investigating increased 502/504 on inference endpoints due to an internal cache issue. Mitigation in progress; no data loss. We will post updates every 30 minutes." Sending now.

sophia_support: posted to affected CSMs + status page update.

monitoring-bot: after flag disable + first rollback batch, error rate dropped to 0.45% in us-west-2 within 9m. Global rate now 0.6%. Timeouts reduced.

ajay_eng: continuing rollback across remaining kv-index replicas. Also discovered a schema mismatch in the on-disk prefix index format when nodes missed a migration — some older nodes still had v1 index header. That explains CRC failures when the new index parser tried to load them. We'll need a safer forward/backward compatible index format.

maria_oncall: good catch. For live mitigation I'm going to: 
- keep prefix_cache_persistent=false on frontends for now
- continue rollback to stable kv-index revision
- add a temporary iptables rule to route new traffic away from kv-54 and kv-57 until they re-sync

kai_sre: applying node routing exclusion: `kubectl annotate nodes kv-54 kv-57 maintenance=true` then update service endpoints.

deploy-bot: endpoints updated: kv-54, kv-57 drained from prefix-service.

monitoring-bot: 5xx now back to baseline (~0.12%) after full rollback + node drain. No new errors from kv-shard logs.

maria_oncall: handoff time. I'll be off for 30m break — handing to @ajay_eng for stabilization and post-incident tasks. Notes left in thread: 
- reason: index format incompat after staged index migration + aggressive eviction tuning exposed older nodes with v1 index headers
- temporary actions: disabled persistent prefix caching on frontends, rolled back kv-index commit abc123, drained problematic kv nodes, warmed caches on stable replicas
- customer impact: ~20 paid customers saw transient 502/504 between 14:02-14:25 PST, estimated affected requests ~3.1% of traffic in region; no data loss, no model outputs incorrect (best-effort retries returned).

ajay_eng: ack takeover. I'll run verification and start remediation tasks: 
1) schedule rolling reformat/migration for v1->v2 index with compatibility safety checks (script with dry-run)
2) create a canary pipeline to validate index migrations on a subset of nodes before applying cluster-wide
3) revert the LFU eviction tweak and add a runtime guard to prevent aggressive eviction unless mem pressure > 85%

sophia_support: created INC-2278 and linked customer tickets. Also opened a status page postmortem placeholder.

kai_sre: post-incident immediate action items: 
- health-check for index CRC on startup -> fail-open and avoid triggering parsing that causes 5xx (log & continue with fallback)
- add stronger schema negotiation in index loader
- automated draining of nodes that fail index verification with an automated recovery workflow

ajay_eng: pushed a quick patch to index loader to tolerate older headers (safe-fail to disk-only mode) and validated on staging. Will schedule full migration plan.

maria_oncall: update for execs: short summary prepared and shared in #incidents-summary.

ajay_eng: final verification at 14:45 PST — error budget safe, monitoring green. I'm keeping prefix_cache_persistent=false until migration rollout next week. Reverting flag will be a controlled rollout after canary migration.

sophia_support: support notified customers with resolution note and ETA for full fix (next week migration).

maria_oncall: closing page. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

ajay_eng: creating postmortem draft (PM-INC-2278) and assigning to eng-runtime + eng-ml for follow-ups.

monitoring-bot: incident closed by @maria_oncall -> incident duration ~43m, peak 5xx 2.7%, resolved to baseline <0.2%

deploy-bot: artifacts: rollback ids: abc123 -> rev12, flag change id ff-745, drained nodes kv-54/57.

maria_oncall: leaving final note: do not re-enable persistent prefix caching until v2 index migration completed and we have canary pass. Also add a post-deploy check in CI that verifies index format version compatibility.

ajay_eng: ack, will add to sprint and track as P1 for runtime team.

sophia_support: marking incident as "resolved" on status page; will keep customers updated about migration schedule.

kai_sre: good job team.
